narr: A band of heavy rain developed during the morning of May 17th and caused flash flooding across portions of Mississippi.
ev: There was flooding on several roads around the Hazlehurst area including Monticello Street, Raymond Road, and Bethesda Road. Eight houses were flooded on Vardaman Street, and residents had to be rescued.
Water covered a portion of Bridgeport Road.
A portion of Hopewell Road was flooded.
A portion of Strong River Road was flooded, and the Strong River Bridge at Highway 13 was flooded.
Floodwaters covered both lanes of Highway 513 near County Road 22.
Water covered County Road 103-1, and entered two homes requiring water rescues.
Floodwaters entered a home, and an occupant had to be rescued. A few roads were closed including CR 1539 and CR 13.
A portion of Clegg Road was flooded.
